description: This file defines the PaymentStatusScreen widget, which displays the result of a payment process, including success/failure status, course unlocking logic, and navigation options. It integrates with provider-based state management for payments and courses.

classes.name: PaymentStatusScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays the payment status (success or failure) and relevant information, handling course unlocking on successful payment.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the payment status screen, displaying success/error icons, texts, and navigation buttons, and triggers course unlocking on successful payment.
